title: Sparkly bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7FE7FF'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2CA8D8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tub body -->
  <rect x='14' y='46' width='72' height='34' rx='10' fill='#F2F7FF'/>
  <!-- tub shading bottom -->
  <path d='M19 68 Q50 78 81 68 L84 72 Q84 78 76 78 L24 78 Q16 78 16 72 Z' fill='#C3D3E8'/>
  <!-- tub rim -->
  <rect x='10' y='40' width='80' height='12' rx='6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='10' y='48' width='80' height='4' fill='#D7E3F2'/>
  <!-- water surface -->
  <rect x='18' y='44' width='64' height='8' rx='4' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='22' y='78' width='8' height='8' rx='2' fill='#9FB4CC'/>
  <rect x='70' y='78' width='8' height='8' rx='2' fill='#9FB4CC'/>
  <!-- faucet -->
  <path d='M72 40 L72 28 Q72 24 76 24 L82 24' stroke='#F5D76E' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='82' y='20' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#F5D76E'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF27A'>
    <path d='M30 14 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 Z'/>
    <path d='M58 10 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 8 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M14 30 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M88 34 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#B6F0FF'>
    <circle cx='44' cy='18' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='1.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
